reasons: The v1 seed-two standalone check omitted per-sensor AP, per-fold recall, and a seed-two paired-site lower-bound gate required by the written research contract.
The v1 masked reconstruction objective zero-filled invalid pixels but did not exclude them from patch normalization or reconstruction/temporal losses.
Future external four-member aggregation was not explicitly frozen.
corrective_action: Start a new hash-bound v2 with observability-weighted loss, exact seed-two pilot gates, explicit external four-member mean-correction aggregation, new seeds, and a new ignored checkpoint directory.
limitations: This artifact contains no development outcome and is not evidence for or against the architecture.
The v1 ignored checkpoints are retained only as an audit trail and may not initialize v2.
